description: List which code repository (and, in a monorepo, which service directory) owns which cost entity (a resource, a Kubernetes workload or namespace, a tag value, a service or a linked account), with the match kind, a 0-1 confidence, the 30-day spend snapshot and whether the mapping is in conflict with another repository. status defaults to confirmed (a person approved it); suggested rows are machine proposals nobody has decided on, and must not be quoted as facts. Decision fields only: no code, file paths or excerpts are returned. `confidence` is a score, not a probability. Confirming and rejecting are app-only. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/repo-mappings.
name: list_repo_cost_mappings
